results.q: How do I download and install the Circles App?
results.a: Circles is a web-based application, so there is no need to download and install anything. Just use an internet browser app and go to http://CirclesUBI.ID to register your Circles account.

results.q: I have internet problems in my area, can I still exchange Circles Points?
results.a: Unfortunately not. Circles is a web-based application that needs internet access to be used. Make sure you are in an area with internet access and your device has an internet connection when you use the Circles application.

results.q: Do I need a phone with special specifications to use Circles?
results.a: Any Smartphone, android or apple, with a camera.
